name: Kalder
description: A hardy town of grey stone on the lip of the northern fells, with hot springs underneath and a long memory.

gate.name: The Fell Gate
gate.description: A small gate in a grey wall, with the fells rising behind the town and the road falling away east to the marsh.

street.name: The High Street
street.description: A steep street of grey stone houses, with smoke from every chimney and a bathhouse on the north side.

arms.name: The Armoury
arms.description: A cold room of racked blades and hanging plate, kept by a woman who clearly does not like it when they are touched.

tools.name: The Pedlar's Stall
tools.description: A covered stall of jars, bundles, rope and bright feathers on strings.

inn.name: The Fell Lantern
inn.description: A warm, low inn whose windows are always lit.

north.failure_message: The old house's door is locked. A brass key would answer it.

bath.name: The Bathhouse
bath.description: A steaming stone bathhouse fed from a hot spring, thick with the smell of sulphur. A back door in the west wall leads out to the lane behind it.

lane1.name: The Back Lane
lane1.description: A narrow lane of wet cobbles behind the bathhouse, running south between blank walls, with the bathhouse door to the east.

lane2.name: The Back Lane, Further Down
lane2.description: The lane runs on south between blank walls.

lane3.name: The Back Lane, Narrowing
lane3.description: The lane squeezes between a woodpile and a wall. Somewhere, steam hisses.

lane4.name: A Corner of the Lane
lane4.description: A little dead-end corner with a cracked flagstone, a drain, and the feeling that someone once hid something here.

west_house.name: The Locked House
west_house.description: A house at the west end of the street. The door is barred, and an old man sits inside by a cold hearth.
